scope: Evidence items resolved by source verification and project-owner review

notes.mapping: Engineered NTS1/DARPin whole-entity mappings remain excluded from pooled generic aggregation; source-aligned receptor segments are used only for exact-identity viewer labels.
notes.tethered: 8XOR and 8XOS contain the endogenous tethered agonist within the deposited PAR1 receptor chain, not as a separate ligand chain.
notes.aminergic_coordinate_review: 2R4R, 2R4S and 3KJ6 have no deposited pharmacological-ligand coordinates; their source annotations remain annotated-not-observed rather than being guessed as apo. 8YN7, 7B6W and 8IRU were reconciled to the curator-confirmed deposited ligand instances.
notes.aminergic_transducer_review: 6E67 has no deposited transducer; 8GG7 does. GPCRdb functional annotations and deposited-chain presence remain distinct fields.
notes.aminergic_site_review: LY2119620 in 4MQT is extracellular; Cmpd-15PA in 5X7D and compound-6FA in 6N48 are intracellular; the phosphoinositide T7M in 8PKM is lipid-facing.
notes.aminergic_site_review_round_2: Owner review classified AS408 in 6OBA and mevidalen in 7CKZ as lipid-facing; mevidalen in 7LJC and 7X2F as intracellular; mevidalen in 7LJD as bitopic. Uncontested proposed classifications were accepted: the muscarinic PAMs in 6OIK, 7T94, 7T96, 7TRP, 7TRQ and 7V68 and the allosteric agonist in 7V6A are extracellular; T7M in 8PJK is lipid-facing.
notes.lipid_review_round_1: 8J24 auxiliary polymers are G protein and antibody; 8WRZ auxiliary polymers are beta-arrestin and antibody. Owner review classified TAK-875 in 4PHU, MK-8666 in 5TZR, and AP8 in 5TZY as spanning the orthosteric pocket toward the extracellular/lipid-facing surface (bitopic/multi-region); 6XQ in 5KW2, Org27569 in 6KQI, and 7IC in 7FEE/7WV9 as lipid-facing; 9T4 in 8J20 as intracellular; and A1D5Q in 8XXU/8XXV as spanning the lipid-facing and intracellular regions (bitopic/multi-region). Supporting source: Scientific Reports 9, 6180 (2019), doi:10.1038/s41598-019-42618-8.
notes.orphan_review_round_1: Owner review confirmed no deposited pharmacological ligand for 7VUY (Gi), 7VUZ (Gi), 7VV3 (Gi), 8IW1 (Gi), or 8IW9 (Gs). 8ZFJ is obsolete and superseded by 9J31; the replacement is ligand-free and Gs-bound. Compound 2/J5F in 7EJX spans the lipid-facing and intracellular regions (bitopic/multi-region). U39/CHEMBL5177388 in 8DWG binds the extracellular vestibule.
notes.nucleotide_review_round_1: Owner review classified BMS compound 16/BUR in 4XNV and the Ago-PAM XTD in 7LD3 as lipid-facing.
notes.alicarboxylic_review_round_1: 8J6L is niacin-bound HCA2-Gi and polymer entity 4 is a signalling-complex component. Compound 9n/IX8 in 8JHY and 8JII is lipid-facing.
notes.steroid_review_round_1: 7BW0 is ligand-free and Gs-bound. In 7CFN, FX0 residue R403 is the orthosteric INT-777 copy and R401 is the lipid-facing allosteric/PAM copy. 8XOH, 8XOI and 8XOJ have no deposited pharmacological ligand; their Gq/antibody components are auxiliary.
notes.other_review_round_1: 5WB1 is ligand-free US28 chain A. 5WB2 has US28 chain A and CX3CL1 chain B; MES B102 is buffer, not ligand. 8K4O has ORF74 receptor chain E and growth-regulated alpha protein ligand chain F. 8K4P has ORF74 receptor chain A, no ligand, and a Gi complex.
notes.sensory_review_round_1: Owner-confirmed deposited orthosteric detergent/alcohol instances were recovered for 4J4Q BOG A405, 4PXF BOG A406, 4X1H BNG A407, 5TE3 BOG A407, 5WKT BOG A405, 6NWE BOG A412, 6PEL ODM A401, 6PGS 64Z A403 and 6PH7 NZZ A407. BOG/BNG also occur at additional allosteric/surface positions in several entries. 4ZWJ, 5DGY and 5W0P contain arrestin/fusion complexes; 6NWE and 6PH7 contain only a short G-protein CT peptide as the transducer component.
notes.protein_review_round_1: 7F1Q, 7F1R and 7F1T have no deposited chemokine ligand. 7XBX residues R1–R124 and 8U1U residues A24–A126 are receptor-fused N-terminal segments occupying the orthosteric/extracellular pocket; they are displayed as tethered interaction segments without assigning agonism. 8K2X CXCL10 is polymer entity 6, chain L, paired with CXCR3 chain R. 8TLM contains antibodies but no deposited pharmacological ligand. REGN7663 Fab chains L/H contact the extracellular vestibule in 8U4Q/R/S/T and are displayed as interaction partners without assigning agonism. 9D3E polymer entity 1, chain A, is the receptor; A1A1W A503 is orthosteric and EBX A502 binds the intracellular GPCR–G-protein interface. 8HNL contains deposited G-protein chains A/B/G although auxiliary chains are hidden by default. Vercirnon in 5LWE, VT5 in 5T1A and EBX in 6LFL bind the intracellular GPCR–G-protein interface. 6MEO has CCR5 receptor chain B and gp160 ligand chain G; other polymer chains are antibodies. 7T9M, 7T9N and 7XW7 remain open because the pharmacological role of their receptor-bound antibodies was not established.
notes.protein_review_round_2: 9D3E/9D3G chain A is a CCR6–BRIL construct: native CCR6 auth 28–241, auth 332–334 corresponding to CCR6 242–244, and auth 357–459 corresponding to CCR6 245–347. Exact-identity motif mapping excludes BRIL/linkers. Their orthosteric ligands and intracellular EBX copies are separately observed. 6MET displays the gp160–CD4 extracellular complex. Glycoprotein-hormone alpha/beta chains in 7FIG, 7FIH, 7FII, 7T9I, 7XW5 and 8I2G are two-chain endogenous ligands, not antibodies. JLW in 6QZH is intracellular; 55Z in 7FIH and HOI/O6F in 7XW5/7XW6/8I2G are extracellular. Z41 in 7UTZ is displayed neutrally as a structural lipid, without assigning pharmacological efficacy.
notes.protein_review_round_3: CS-17 in 7T9M, M22 Fab in 7T9N and K1-70 scFv in 7XW7 are not counted as pharmacological ligands. They remain available only as antibody interaction partners in the 3D viewer; their contact shells are restricted to receptor extracellular N-terminal ectodomain/ECL1/ECL2/ECL3 residues within 5 Å. The deposited contacts fall in the large TSHR N-terminal ectodomain rather than the three short ECL segments.
